implementation_notes: Preserve long blades and four distinct silhouettes. Concept surface veins are illustrative; use established geometric emissive materials and reduced glow if implemented. Purple final concept has an open crescent cutout, not the closed aperture requested in the prompt; follow approved final image. Existing long dagger test stats: damage 75, speed 1.6.

concepts.name: 余烬·断霆
concepts.design: Design: a powerful red lightning-shaped long dagger. The single connected blade follows a bold shallow Z in its broad planar spine, with two angular elbows and one long oblique stabbing tip. An uninterrupted sharpened cutting edge follows the opposite contour. A heavy rhomboid blade root, short offset trapezoid guard, clean thick straight grip, slanted wedge pommel. The silhouette is angular and aggressive, NOT a saw, NOT a fork, NOT an ordinary symmetrical sword. Palette crimson red, coral highlights, dark ruby faces. Small red zigzag spark fragments breaking away from the two blade elbows.
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: polished fantasy game weapon concept illustration for the Arcane Armory heteromorphic series, intended to later build as a Skyrim long dagger. ONE weapon only, full-length vertical composition, tip upward, all extremities in frame with generous margins. Dark charcoal background. Near-orthographic three-quarter view with very slight angle revealing geometric thickness. Long substantial blade about 3 times the length of the one-hand grip, total weapon roughly a forearm-and-a-half, visibly a long dagger rather than a tiny knife or full sword. Elegant bold architectural geometry, thick solid planar forms, sharply readable silhouette, believable continuous structural connections. The entire weapon is made of colored luminous energy with darker colored faces and narrow softly fluorescent edges, NOT shiny metallic material, not crystal gemstone textures. Emission restrained enough to preserve saturated color and clear facets. Grip is a straight smooth unobstructed palm-length bar, guards above the fingers; no shapes cutting through the hand. Sparse small localized colored particles near the blade, no giant aura, no magic circles, no hexagram, no character, no text, no labels, no watermark. concepts.name: 流萤·脉翎
concepts.design: Design: an elegant jade green long leaf-shaped dagger. Long asymmetrical willow-leaf blade with a convex continuous cutting edge, an oblique needle point. Three substantial staggered diagonal geometric cutouts along the inner spine create a feather-rib architecture; all ribs structurally joined by a thick continuous backbone and blade perimeter. No sickle hook or curls. A swept single-sided feather-shaped guard above the grip, clean straight thick grip, flattened hexagonal pommel. Broad graceful blade body, solid readable negative spaces, not thin wire. Palette emerald green, jade and mint edge highlights, deep green faces. A few mint diamond leaflike motes drifting beside the cutouts.

concepts.name: 寒汐·折阶
concepts.design: Design: an architectural blue cyan long dagger with a straight uninterrupted razor edge and a broad stepped spine. The blade resembles three large interlocking offset rectangular terraces fused into one long monolithic blade, converging to a sharply diagonal tanto point. Each step is meaningful and oversized, only three steps, not tiny serrations. A narrow inset cyan luminous channel follows the three steps. Compact rectangular crossguard with a single open square guard loop ABOVE the fingers, substantial straight handle, rectangular capped pommel. Strong asymmetrical linear silhouette, no spear-shaped central slot. Palette petrol blue and turquoise faces, icy cyan fluorescent edges. Small short cyan rectangular particles floating parallel to the terraces.

concepts.name: 梦隙·蚀月
concepts.design: Design: a mysterious purple long crescent dagger. A substantial wide single blade sweeps in a restrained elegant arc and terminates in one upward-pointing long triangular tip; a thick shorter inner crescent rib connects at both the root and upper blade shoulder, enclosing one off-center crescent aperture. Asymmetrical crescent cross section and angled planar bevels, no floating disconnected blade pieces. A tilted open diamond guard ABOVE the fingers cradles the root, simple straight thick grip, short faceted drop pommel. Blade remains long and narrow enough to read as a dagger, not a sickle with sideways blade. Palette rich violet, orchid and lavender edge highlights, dark plum faces. Tiny lavender crescent motes gathered near the aperture, controlled delicate glow.
